                    ### Question

Examination of the left ear shows a bulging tympanic membrane with green discharge. Gram stain of the discharge shows a gram-negative coccobacillus. The isolated organism grows on chocolate agar. The causal pathogen most likely produces a virulence factor that acts by which of the following mechanisms?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Binding of the Fc region of immunoglobulins
opb. Inactivation of 60S ribosome
opc. Overactivation of adenylate cyclase
opd. Cleavage of secretory immunoglobulins
ope. Inactivation of elongation factor
